assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (highest group_id in the seed is 18); the task creates one user_group row
active = 1 kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy, and consistent with a newly established group
org_id 1 is the organisation of the acting user, Travis Wood and case HRC0000711

requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group_member WHERE member_id = 44 AND group_id = 19 AND user_id = 11 AND org_id = 1
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (highest member_id in the seed is 43); the task creates one user_group_member row
Travis Wood resolved to user 11, the only user of that name
the transfer's destination is the new Lead HR Support group (19), which he is heading

assumptions: HRC0000711 resolved to hr_case 1 by number (assignment group 4, HR Service Desk, on the seed)

assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (highest hr_case_task_id in the seed is 149); the task creates one hr_case_task row
status = 'ready' and active = 1 kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy

hr_case_assignment_group_update.evidence: its updated_at > created_at predicate tests only a server-kept timestamp and is dropped; number = 'HRC0000711' is the display column of the anchored row hr_case 1; the reassignment itself is carried by the assignment_group cell

notes: The membership transfer is two requirements, the new Lead HR Support membership and the removal of the Global Service Desk one; the benchmark's membership check is a conjunction of both and is carried by each. complete_transaction_integrity_check is a conjunction of cells the other checks test (group, both membership changes, case assignment group, task) and is carried jointly by every requirement. Travis Wood (user 11) is already assigned_to on HRC0000711 and will be a member of Lead HR Support, so the policy's rule that assignees be active members of the assignment group holds without further change; assigned_to is not tested. The acting user Karen Watkins holds the admin role, which the policy gives full write access but bars from routine HR case work; the case reassignment and task belong to an organisational change, so they are still required.
